title: Coastal Reset | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Coastal Reset', your dream beach getaway along scenic 30A in Seacrest where laid-back luxury meets total privacy and effortless coastal living. Perfectly positioned between Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, Seaside, and The Big Chill, you’re minutes from the best dining, shopping, and entertainment. This beautifully designed one-level home makes vacation living easy and comfortable for everyone in your group, with two separate living spaces so there’s room to spread out, relax, and unwind. Whether it’s movie night, quiet reading time, or giving kids and adults their own hangout zones, you’ll never feel crowded. Plus, with two dedicated workspaces, it’s ideal for remote work, school, or sneaking in a quick check-in while still enjoying paradise. Step outside and you’ll find what truly sets Coastal Reset apart, a private pool all your own. No crowded community pools, no waiting for chairs, just your personal oasis to cool off, lounge, and soak up the sun in total peace. When the beach calls, you’re just a short walk to beach access, making it effortless to go from poolside to sugar-white sand in minutes. Exploring 30A is part of the experience, and you’ll do it in style with your included 6-seater golf cart. Cruise to nearby hotspots, grab dinner, or catch a sunset with ease. Prefer a slower pace? Take the adult bikes out for a ride along scenic paths, stopping for coffee, shopping, or a quick dip in the Gulf along the way. This isn’t just a place to stay, it’s your reset. FEATURES: Private Pool Beach Access Short Walk From Home 6-Seater Golf Cart 6 Bikes- Adult Large Covered Back Patio with Seating 2 Dedicated Working Spaces Fully Equipped Kitchen Full Washer & Dryer Smart TVs Gas Grill Complimentary Wifi Beach Gear 3 Dedicated Parking Spots to Rosemary + Alys Beach Corn Hole Set Lawn Bean Bags Perfect for Relaxing ACCOMMODATIONS: FIRST FLOOR -Bathrooms-Dining-Kitchen-Living Rooms Coastal Reset accommodates up to 13 people (all on first floor): -Bedroom #1: Queen -Bedroom #2: Twin over Double With Trundle -Bedroom #3: Queen With Ensuite -Bedroom #4: King -Bedroom #5: (Master Bedroom) King with Ensuite -Sleeper Sofa **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Three parking spaces available (3 driveway) Included is a 6-seater golf cart & 6 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. SEACREST COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: Seacrest is casually upscale, making it easy for guests to find endless relaxation. Turn off your phone and forget about your emails as you explore all that Seacrest has to offer. The area’s legendary sugar-white sand and turquoise water are only part of what makes Seacrest a true getaway. NEARBY BEACH ACCESS 1. Seacrest Drive Access is on Scenic 30A at the intersection of Seacrest Drive. A short boardwalk leads to a dune walkover high atop a bluff overlooking the Gulf of Mexico. 2. Seabreeze Beach Access in Seacrest is on Scenic 30A at the intersection of Seabreeze Trail, about 1/2 mile east of Camp Creek Lake. It has a shower but no parking. A short boardwalk through a coastal grove leads to a dune walkover high atop a bluff with a commanding view of the Gulf of Mexico. 3. Gulf Lakes Access is on Scenic 30A about 1/4 mile east of Camp Creek Lake and about 100 yards east of Pelican Circle. Halfway down the boardwalk there is a bike rack and shower but no car parking. The dune walkover sits on a high bluff overlooking the gulf. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including front porch. Additional cleaning charges of $500 will be charged if in violation. *Capacity for 3 vehicles in the driveway. *No parties or events. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues, no wifi, or slow wifi. *Space must remain pet free! IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Other things to note
